responsibility: Contains the executable rustc driver frontends for the Cranelift backend. One binary (`cg_clif`) is the normal driver that always invokes rustc with Cranelift-specific callbacks, backend selection, panic/sysroot defaults, argument normalization, and ICE reporting; the other (`cg_clif_build_sysroot`) is the sysroot-building driver that decides between the default LLVM path and the Cranelift path, keeping host builds on the normal backend while switching target builds to Cranelift with the appropriate settings. Together these files provide the command-line entry points that launch rustc with the right backend and configuration for general Cranelift compilation and for sysroot construction.
